note: Bounded 2026–27 catalog and directory review found no qualifying official undergraduate title: inspected the full admissions major/minor directory and all 32 option/minor pages linked under Graduation Requirements, including their formal track/concentration headings and relevant text. Followed the mechanical engineering department to its June 2026 list of eight pre-approved tracks. Electrical Engineering Intelligent Systems, Robotics, Information and Data Sciences, and Computation and Neural Systems do not meet the AI-title rule. Individualized EAS/ISP proposals, research areas and AI courses are not confirmed AI-titled awards. This dated source-scope result is not proof of universal or future absence; recheck new catalog editions and official program announcements. See research/caltech-catalog-review-2026-10-11.md for the complete inspected-page ledger.
